name: smwmusic-lagrange-point-broken-replicaizer
title: Lagrange Point - Broken Replicaizer
description:
The tense and upbeat song from the fake final boss battle.
This song is very heavy on sample usage, making it not compatible with Thunder SFX, and having to ommit @7 and @17.

There's two soundfonts included inside the port, one that was extracted from the NSF files, and Famitracker, and other from the ROM through an emulator. To choose between the two, change the "ROM_Soundfont" define to 0 to use the NSF soundfont, and vice-versa.
